purpose: Fix the injection and binning BEFORE the characterization measurement, so the measurement characterizes a pre-declared candidate rather than a choice made after seeing the numbers.
does_not_ratify: No acceptance threshold is ratified by this file.
No non-inferiority margin, switching threshold or adequacy criterion is ratified.
The reference value these choices imply is a REFERENCE MODEL, NOT A PROVEN BOUND.
Ratification of U1-U8 remains Joseph's, per ENDPOINT_EAVAIL_SPECIFICATION-20260918.md section 7.

injection.standardization: z = clip((x - p50)/IQR, -c, +c), quantiles over the injected population only
injection.amplitude_rationale: z is IQR-standardized, so a is DIMENSIONLESS and the induced per-event weight range exp(+-1.05) is identical to the pT injection's. The amplitude therefore transfers even though the displacement FIELD it produces does not -- which is exactly the distinction the reference calibration rests on.

binning.provenance: the CAMPAIGN'S OWN canonical axis: unfold_nd_omnifold_unbinned.EXTRA_AXES['eavail']['edges'], used by the 3D/4D extensions and by the covariance projection.
binning.why_this_and_not_a_new_binning: It predates this endpoint and was chosen for the N-D analysis, so it cannot have been chosen to suit this measurement. Inventing edges here would invite exactly the suspicion the instruction warns against.
binning.low_acceptance_regions: RETAINED. Bin edges are not adjusted to remove or dilute poorly accepted regions: doing so would raise the reference value, flatter both arms, and delete the region where a better hadronic representation is most likely to matter. Results are reported stratified by acceptance, each stratum against its own reference value.

secondary_domain.name: canonical extended-FPS (pT, p_parallel) grid
secondary_domain.role: CO-REPORTED DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, no decision weight. It is the campaign's reporting grid, so a result must be placeable against the existing record.

statistic.primary: recovery = 1 - E_w[|1 - r_b|] over the primary domain
statistic.mandatory_decomposition: signed response E_w[r] and scatter penalty E_w[|1-r|] - |1-E_w[r]|, per BEN-038, because an arm can win the aggregate by being less noisy per cell
statistic.reference_model: ceiling(k, w) = sum_b w_b (1-(1-a_b)^k) / sum_b w_b, with w = injected displacement |prior_b - target_b|; implemented in reference_calibration.py and validated against the committed acceptance-map product
statistic.reference_model_not_a_proven_bound: The construction assumes displacement reaches a cell only through that cell's acceptance. omnifold.py:218-220 lets a smooth learner transport a tilt across cells, and BEN-038 measured a band at E_w[r] = 1.0333, above the modelled reachable value. Graded ASSUMED in FINDING-20260806-niter4-decision.md.

what_the_measurement_will_report: the truth E_avail distribution over truth-passing rows, and its p25/p50/p75
the per-bin reco acceptance a_b on the primary domain, by the committed formula
the injected displacement field |prior_b - target_b| on BOTH domains for this candidate tilt
the reference value implied on both domains at k = 1..4
the acceptance-stratified census, so poorly accepted regions are visible rather than absorbed
